package.name: sicktoolbox
package.description:
SICK Toolbox drivers for SICK laser rangefinders.
This package contains the ROS2 port of the SICK LIDAR Matlab/C++ Toolbox.
The SICK LIDAR Matlab/C++ Toolbox offers stable and easy-to-use C++ drivers for SICK LMS 1xx, LMS 2xx and LD LIDARs.
Also included are configuration utilities, examples, and tutorials.
